title: Cross-team launch plan for Console observability: dashboards, rollout controls, and granular cost breakdowns
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Coordinate a cross-functional launch for three Console UX features: (1) Per-route and per-model cost breakdowns in the Cost Insights dashboard, (2) New Rollouts UI with canary/A-B toggle and automatic fallback policies, and (3) Updated Observability Dashboards (latency, tokens, per-route SLOs). This ticket is the PM playbook to align Engineering, Design, Docs, Support, Sales, and Marketing for release day and the two-week ramp. Scope includes release notes, training content, support playbook, launch checklist, and measuring post-launch health. Out of scope: backend-only infra upgrades not exposed in Console; Dedicated private install bundles (handled in ENG-2939).
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated release notes drafted and approved by Product & Engineering
Support and Solutions teams have a playbook and runbook with troubleshooting steps and known limitations
Design sign-off on final UI and screenshots for docs and marketing
Two internal training sessions (recorded) scheduled and materials uploaded to Drive
Console feature flags and rollout policy can be toggled by region/tier per rollout plan
Monitoring dashboards in Grafana/NewRelic show baseline and post-launch metrics and alert thresholds
Customer-facing docs and quickstart guides live at docs.redwood.com before GA

rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): feature-flag on for internal orgs and beta customers (2025-02-27 to 2025-03-03). Run smoke tests and synthetic load for cost calculations. Phase 2 (canary): enable for 10% of GA traffic for hosted tier, monitor KPIs for 48h. Automatic fallback on error thresholds (error rate > 1% or P95 latency > 2x baseline). Phase 3 (gradual): 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 7 days with daily health checks and stakeholder signoff. Dedicated/private customers will be notified with upgrade notes and optional on-prem bundle instructions in ENG-2939. Rollback plan: manual rollback via feature flag + immediate mitigation playbook in Support runbook.

messaging_guidelines: Customer-facing messaging should focus on: (1) operational visibility — per-route and per-model cost transparency to reduce unit costs, (2) safer rollouts — canary and automatic fallback reduce risk of regressions, (3) actionable insights — dashboards surface cost/latency hot spots. Avoid promising automated cost savings; instead emphasize tooling to identify and act on opportunities. Use provided screenshots and short gifs in marketing assets. Coordinate subject lines with Growth (suggested: 'New in Console: Cost Insights & Safer Rollouts').
release_notes: Summary: Console now includes Per-Route Cost Breakdowns, an improved Observability Dashboard (latency, token usage, SLO tracking), and a Rollouts workspace with canary/A-B toggles and automatic fallback. Breaking changes: none. API changes: optional metadata field for routes (route_id) exposed — clients should include route_id to map costs. Known limitations: cost aggregation for long-running streaming sessions may lag up to 5 minutes. See docs for migration notes.
metrics_to_track: Adoption: % of orgs viewing Cost Insights within 14 days
Rollout failure rate / automatic fallbacks triggered
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Cost calculations are heavy and may increase telemetry load - Mitigation: use sampled telemetry in first week and backfill full aggregation offline
Risk: Customers misinterpret cost graphs and take aggressive downscaling actions - Mitigation: include clear guidance and example queries in docs and add in-app tooltips
Risk: Rollout gating thresholds too strict causing false fallback - Mitigation: tune thresholds with staging traffic and provide manual override for Solutions team
Risk: Incomplete docs at GA - Mitigation: freeze docs one business day before GA and require PM sign-off
